notes: Form N-14 (filed 2021-02-19, pre-effective) with a combined prospectus/information statement for an open-end fund-to-fund reorganisation within Matthews International Funds: Matthews Emerging Asia Fund (Target) into Matthews Asia Small Companies Fund (Acquiring, to be renamed). No shareholder vote is required (Rule 17a-8); the filing says so. Exchange is by aggregate NAV; the share count is not stated, so exchange_ratio is null. Fee-table, expense-cap, turnover and transaction-cost figures are bracketed placeholders in the excerpt and are not used. Target-fund and acquiring-fund share classes are named in the excerpt; no tickers are stated, so subject_tickers is null. n_targets left null (one target implied, not stated as a count). Expected completion is the 'on or about April 29, 2021' date as stated in the excerpt; termination, record and meeting dates are not stated. security_class is 'other' because the filing offers open-end fund shares of beneficial interest. Excerpt ends inside the appendix on investment restrictions, so later terms are not in front of the reader.
